decisions.executionNote: Approach the front-right tube with the right arm; raise and gradually tilt into an elbow-up overhead grasp. Left arm stays home.
Continue toward the front tube, rotating the open gripper to align with its diagonal axis. Keep clearance above the table.
Finish downward alignment above the front tube and lower cautiously while keeping the gripper open.
Fine-align the front tube between the fingers, descend to body height, and close fully. Retention will be checked by lifting.
Lift the first tube clear of the table while maintaining a fully closed grip; check that it moves with the wrist.
Tube retained in RGB. Begin rotating it upright and moving toward the rack's right side, maintaining clearance and a closed grip.
Continue the smooth upright rotation and approach above a right-side large rack slot. No release until vertical alignment and insertion.
Finish making the tube vertical over the rightmost large front-row opening, using the observed wrist pose for the final alignment.
Lower the upright tube toward the right-front opening, with a small inward alignment correction. Keep it held and inspect before final seating.
Insert straight down into the aligned right-side slot with small vertical steps; keep the tube closed in the gripper until seated.
Complete a shallow final seating motion, then open the gripper fully and let the first tube settle in the rack.
First tube is standing after release. Withdraw the open right gripper away from the rack and lift to prepare for the next pickup.
Move above the remaining tube nearest the rack and gradually orient the open gripper along its axis, keeping clear of the seated tube.
Continue overhead alignment with the second tube while keeping the open fingers well above it and away from the rack.
Finish the downward-facing orientation and approach the second tube's body slowly. Inspect wrist alignment before closing.
Use the wrist view to shift along the second tube toward its cap while lowering the open fingers around the body.
Fine-center the fingers at the second tube's body, lower the final few millimeters, and close fully before a retention check.
Lift and retract the second tube clear of the rack and table with the grip fully closed, checking retention in the wrist view.
Second tube is retained. Begin rotating it upright while moving inward toward a central large slot, staying above the rack.
Continue upright rotation with extra height so the held tube clears the already seated tube while moving toward the center slot.
Finish the second tube's upright alignment above the central opening, holding clearance over the rack before descending.
Lower toward the center slot while turning the wrist slightly away from the seated right tube, preserving the held tube's vertical axis and slot alignment.
Insert the second tube vertically into the central opening in small steps, retaining the grip until seating is visually checked.
The tube met resistance and shifted in the fingers; stop lowering and open gently to let its tip settle into the opening, then inspect before withdrawing.
Retract the open fingers straight away from the rack before lifting, allowing the released tubes to settle without further side contact.
Move clear to the right and raise toward the remaining tube, slowly tilting the open gripper. Inspect the rack again once the arm no longer occludes it.
Continue toward the far-right tube above table height. The middle tube appears tilted after settling and will need reinspection and correction.
Align the open right gripper above the last table tube, completing the downward orientation with gradual joint-continuous motion.
Refine the last tube's axis alignment from the wrist image and descend with the fingers open, stopping above grasp height for inspection.
Lower to grasp height with a small axis-centering correction, then close fully around the last table tube.
Lift the last table tube and retract to a clear transit height with the grip fully closed. The tilted rack tube will need correction afterward.
Carry the retained tube inward at clearance height, beginning a smooth upright rotation while staying on the right side.
Continue inward above the rack with the retained tube, maintaining high clearance and the right elbow-up configuration.
Bring the tube upright over a clear, widely separated rack opening. Keep the right wrist on its side of center and avoid the tilted tube.
Use the calibrated head view to refine left-front slot alignment while lowering only to a clearance height; retain the tube for a closer check.
Correct the tube inward from the visible rack edge and lower cautiously; visual alignment is uncertain, so stop above final seating for inspection.
The tube is obstructed before seating. Unload upward, restore verticality, and shift slightly farther into the rack before another shallow descent.
Retry insertion with the tube vertical and slightly inside the left-front opening, using small downward increments and monitoring for obstruction.
Unload the rim contact, shift the held tube a small distance deeper over the opening, and probe gently without forcing downward.
Lift fully clear of the rim and realign toward the left-front slot, using the seated right tube as a spatial reference. Avoid further pushing while alignment is uncertain.
Lower vertically at the revised left-front alignment and inspect the tube and tracking before committing to final depth.
Continue a shallow vertical seating motion at the revised alignment, watching for any renewed tube slip or rim resistance.
Stop the obstructed descent. Lift clear, then shift the tube deeper toward the hole indicated by its projected tip, restoring vertical orientation.
Descend gently at the deeper alignment, with a final small forward correction to bring the tip into the opening.
Lift fully away from rim contact before further correction; the tube has shifted within the grasp, so reassess its actual tip rather than pushing down.
Reposition the lifted tube a few millimeters inward and forward over the left-front large hole, then approach cautiously from above.
The tube is clear and aligned above the opening. Lower slightly, then open gradually to let it settle under gravity instead of forcing it against the rim.
Withdraw the open gripper without dragging the released tube, then raise for an unobstructed inspection of all rack positions.
Clear the rack for an unobstructed inspection; the last tube tipped over and needs a fresh grasp rather than further insertion attempts.
Withdraw the right arm while raising the left arm in its own workspace to inspect and recover the tube lying on the rack's left side.
